svg.title: AI Alchemy: one connected operation
svg.desc: An isometric system-architecture drawing in five parts. Four business systems stand apart on their own plinths: a stack of spreadsheets, a mail pigeonhole, a filing cabinet with a drawer pulled open, and a legacy tape cabinet. Each ends in an open, unconnected plug. The connections are planned: a collector gathers the four lines into one bundle, beside a drafting plate with a measured plan, proposed massing, a scale rule and a survey station. A gantry lowers a new module into a rack while the legacy core, drawn as a dashed outline, waits to be replaced. The bundle runs through the rack. On a circular platform, a gimballed core does the automated work on a conveyor, and a striped approval boom and a manager's lever keep people in control. The bundle runs under a raised floor of rack rows and data stores and arrives at a single terminal: one connected operation.

g.text: ILLUSTRATION OF THE METHOD, NOT A CLIENT PROJECT.
1. ONE TEAM FROM STRATEGY TO GO-LIVE. BUILT IN-HOUSE.
3. MANAGERS KEEP APPROVAL OVER TECHNICAL, PRICING,
4. DRAWN IN ONE COORDINATE SYSTEM. SEE ANCHORS.JSON.
